# S21 — Y/N answers and defaults for ork run prompts

The ork run prompts (well-specified, split, confirm) take y or n, any case, as well as yes or no, and Enter takes the default shown in the prompt. Flags and --yes are unchanged (adj 86).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Typing the whole word for each prompt is slow. Owner request 2026-10-19.

## Files

- `internal/cli/run.go` (prompts), its tests, `docs/design.md` (CLI), `--help` text if it mentions the prompt.

## Failing tests

- Each prompt accepts y, Y, yes, n, N, no (any case); anything else is an error as today.
- The prompt text shows the default, as [Y/n] or [y/N]; Enter alone takes it.
- Defaults are proposed, pending the owner: well-specified and split have no obvious default, so Enter on them is an error until the owner picks; the confirm prompt defaults to No because launch is a paid action.
- --yes and --well-specified/--split flags behave as before.

## Implement

Change the prompt reader in `internal/cli/run.go` and its tests; docs/design.md CLI section.
